utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the thirtieth of January. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Sorry, only just sat down. Traffic on the ring road was ridiculous.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You and half the shift, by the sound of it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Twenty minutes looking at the same van. Lovely start.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: There is a birthday cake in the office, if that improves things.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There is, yeah. A birthday cake in the office and already a suspiciously large bit missing.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Define large.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Ah. Found the culprit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes an investigation into cake losses—where are we with yesterday?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah so, already swapped the filter on the spinner yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: All finished, nothing left hanging on that?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, all finished. Not carrying it into today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And tested the newer turbine yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Oh, good. That's the one you had on test when I went past?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's it. Finished yesterday, behaved itself. Both of those are off my list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Useful to have some things actually off the list.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: saw the pressure on the site water dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Back up without anyone touching anything?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. A brief dip, then back. Not putting a job forward for that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing here—I saw the pressure on the line 2 robot dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Was that still down when you left it, or—

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, sorry, talking over you. Back on its own before I left. Just something I noticed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, both observations, not new work we're allocating this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the Line 3 Screw and Barrel. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, that's still held on parts.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: So that isn't available to get on with, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No. Still blocked, not a job for today. Right, the actual work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team by Wednesday? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. Wednesday coming, just so I've got the right week in my head?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, by Wednesday. Normal priority, no rush job on it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Less controversial subject than cake portions, hopefully.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Wouldn't count on it with this lot.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ash, can you replace the seals on the big valve by the gate? Monday for that, and it's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Monday, yeah? Not something you're wanting squeezed into today?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Monday, yes. Fairly important, so I do want that one kept in view.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Understood. I'll replace the seals on the big valve by the gate on Monday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the seals only we're talking about, not replacing the whole thing?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, just the seals on the big valve by the gate. That's the scope.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll schedule downtime for the water ring with production after lunch. That's normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, boss. After lunch is when you're sorting the slot with production?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the scheduling with production after lunch. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, nearly jumped in there. We're not saying the water ring actually stops after lunch?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. That's when I'm scheduling it, not an agreed shutdown time.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ash, the other one for you: can you run a function test on the desiccant unit today, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, so that one's a fit-it-in today rather than drop everything?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Whenever you get a chance, but today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Fine, I'll run a function test on the desiccant unit today, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just the function test, then? Nothing bigger wrapped into that?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, just the function test. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'll check the guarding on the main conveyor first thing tomorrow. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus Hale. Tomorrow being Saturday—you do mean tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, first thing tomorrow. I'll check the guarding on the main conveyor then. Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, tomorrow rather than Monday. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah. My week doesn't end just because yours does.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: All right, that's the agreed list. The parts job stays blocked and the two pressure dips were observations only.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the cake losses remain unproven.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: You've got icing on your sleeve, mate.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Still a better morning than the ring road.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, on that very technical note, thanks everyone. See you out there.
